project_info.theme: Toyota ownership peace of mind and value preservation
project_info.color_palette: Light blue, white, navy, soft brown

main_subject.detail: A checklist-style poster with three large blue check-mark bullets reading 'AN TAM TREN MOI HANH TRINH', 'TIET KIEM LUC CHI PHI BAO DUONG', and 'BAO TOAN GIA TRI XE'. In the lower half, a family of four smiles from inside a white Toyota vehicle: father driving, mother in the front passenger seat, and two children in the back. The background is a pale blue gradient with faint city-skyline silhouettes.
main_subject.style: Clean family-benefit infographic combining straightforward checklist messaging with a reassuring real-car family portrait
